title: Scalar compatibility of the transported affine tensor counit
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $A=f_*\mathcal O_U$, $\rho:\mathcal O_X\to A$ the structure map, $R$ pushforward of modules to A-module sheaves and $S$ restriction along $\rho$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $I=f^{-1}$ on A-modules and $IA=f^{-1}A$, $r_0:f^{-1}\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_U$ for the structure map, $t_0=f^{-1}\rho$, and $e:IA\to\mathcal O_U$ for the ring-sheaf counit. Let $b:\mathcal O_U\to B$ and $t:IA\to B$ form a pushout of $r_0,t_0$, and let $\epsilon:B\to\mathcal O_U$ satisfy $b\epsilon=1$ and $t\epsilon=e$. Let $P$ be a functor from A-module sheaves to B-module sheaves, with specified identifications $P(G)=B\otimes_{IA}I(G)$ and map $P(a)$ the transported sheafification of $1\otimes I(a)$. Let $\kappa:P\operatorname{Res}_b\simeq S f^*$ be a natural isomorphism, where $f^*$ is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. All tensor products are scalar-first and sheafified [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Assume for every open $V$ of X and $g\in G(V)$ that $\kappa_G^{-1}(\eta^{f^*}_{SG,V}(g))=\theta_t(1\otimes\eta^{\mathrm{ab}}_{G,V}(g))$ over $f^{-1}V$, where $\theta_t$ is the tensor sheafification unit and $\eta^{\mathrm{ab}}$ the abelian inverse-image unit, and $\eta^{f^*}$ is the unit of the canonical adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Then for each O_U-module sheaf F, open W of U, c in B(W), and p in P(RF)(W), write q_W(p)=counit_F,W(kappa_RF,W(p)). The scalar identity q_W(c p)=epsilon_W(c) q_W(p) holds. This asserts only compatibility with scalar multiplication, and neither constructs a morphism of module sheaves nor asserts its additivity or naturality.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01SB (lemma-affine-equivalence-modules), construction of h and elucidation

proof.text: Write ηA for the ring inverse-image unit. Applying the ring Hom equivalence to the definition of e gives ηA followed by f_*(e) equal to the identity. Since t followed by ε equals e, the identity on the sections of RF is an A-linear morphism g from RF to the direct image of F with IA-action through t followed by ε.

Use the inverse-image module Hom equivalence to obtain v:I(RF) → Res_t Res_ε F as the inverse adjunct of g. Use the change-of-rings Hom equivalence to obtain a B-linear map d:B tensor_IA I(RF) → Res_ε F. The two equivalences have explicit section formulas. Applying their inverse identities shows d(theta_t(1 tensor η_ab(m)))=m for every section m of RF over V.
Transport d along pobj to a B-linear map dP:P(RF) → Res_ε F. Its underlying additive map is O_U-linear after restriction along b because ε(b(r))=r, by hb. Call that O_U-linear map dU.

Compose κ inverse with dU to get a:tensorPullback f (S(RF)) → F. Compute its adjunct using homEquiv_unit. The hP unit formula replaces eqToHom(pobj) applied to κ inverse of the tensor-pullback unit by theta_t(1 tensor η_ab(m)); the evaluation formula of the preceding step sends this to m. Thus the adjunct of a is the identity. Injectivity of the canonical tensor-pullback Hom equivalence, and homEquiv_symm_id, give a=counit_F.

Evaluate that equality on κ(p) and cancel κ inverse composed with κ to obtain dP(p)=counit_F(κ(p)) on every open. Apply B-linearity of dP, whose target B-action is through ε, to obtain the stated scalar identity. This works without using the pushout hypothesis or any local generation assertion.

proof_origin.note: Explicit evaluation by the two canonical Hom equivalences (Stacks 008A and 008Y), followed by uniqueness under the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction (0096). Replaces the local-generation/pushout comparison in the former plan. Stacks 01SB supplies the construction being compared; the formal adjunction uniqueness argument is written by this worker.

theorem affine_module_tensor_counit_smul
    (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u}) (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B)
    (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf) (hpush : IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t)
    (hb : b ≫ ε = 𝟙 U.sheaf) (ht : t ≫ ε = e₀)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B))
        (pobj : ∀ G, P.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} t (I G))
        (κ : P ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 b) ≅ S ⋙ tensorPullback f)
    (hP :
        (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
          P.map a = eqToHom (pobj G) ≫
            SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} t (I G)
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap f.base A G a) ≫
            eqToHom (pobj G').symm) ∧
        (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) (g : G.val.obj V),
          ((eqToHom (pobj G)).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
            ((κ.inv.app G).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
              (((adj₀).unit.app ((S).obj G)).val.app V g)) =
            ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
              (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t (I G))).app
                ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
                ((1 : B.obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
                  ⊗ₜ[(IA).obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V),(t.hom.app
                    ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom]
                  (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                    (Opens.map f.base) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (𝓙 X) (𝓙 U)).unit.app
                      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (𝓡 A)).obj G)).hom.app V g)))) :
    ∀ (F : U.Modules) (W : (Opens U)ᵒᵖ) (c : B.obj.obj W)
      (p : (P.obj ((R).obj F)).val.obj W),
      ((adj₀).counit.app F).val.app W ((κ.hom.app ((R).obj F)).val.app W (c • p)) =
        (ε.hom.app W c) •
          ((adj₀).counit.app F).val.app W ((κ.hom.app ((R).obj F)).val.app W p)
